full_judgment: "Where and in so far as a decree is Varied or reversed in any appeal, revision or other proceeding or is set aside or modified in any suit instituted for the purpose, the court which passed the decree shall, on the application of any party entitled to any benefit by way of restitution or otherwise, cause such restitution to be made as will so far as may be, place the parties in the position which they occupied but for such decree or such part thereof as has been varied, or reversed, set aside or modified and, for this purpose; the court may make any orders, including orders for the refund of costs, and for the payment of interest, damages, compensation and mesne profits, which are properly consequential on such variation, reversal, setting aside or modification of the decree. (2) No suit shall be instituted for the purpose of obtaining any restitution or other relief which could be obtained by application under sub section (1)".
